subtasks.title: Webview folder/file picker for headless mode
subtasks.prompt:
Implement the full feature described in PLAN.md end to end, in this one slice:

1. `src/mainview/lib/api.ts` — change `pickRefs` to return a discriminated `PickRefsResult` (`{kind:"refs",refs}` | `{kind:"candidates",candidates}`), discriminating on `r.candidates !== undefined` (not falsy `refs`). Export `PickRefsResult`. Add `selectPickedRef(path, mode)` hitting `POST /refs/pick/select`, letting `j`'s thrown `ApiError` carry the 400 error message.

2. New file `src/mainview/components/kanban/FolderPickerDialog.tsx` — dialog with a `list`/`fileslist` state machine per PLAN.md §2: manual-path input (separate from the filter input) resolving `~`/relative paths like `DirPickerOverlay.resolveManualPath` (copy locally, drop `~` expansion if `node:os` `homedir()` isn't usable client-side — verify by grepping `from "node:path"` under src/mainview first), case-insensitive substring filter over candidates (no re-sort/dedupe), candidate-row click → `selectPickedRef`; folder mode closes via `onDone(refs)`, files mode shows the returned refs as a second-level list with Back; a file row click resolves directly via `onDone([fileRefs[i]])` (no network call). Errors surface inline (`rowError`/`manualError`) without closing the dialog. Cancel/Escape → `onDone([])`. Use `Dialog` from `@/components/ui/dialog`; candidate/file rows are real `<button>` elements for keyboard accessibility (AC-12). Add the test ids listed in PLAN.md §2.

3. `src/mainview/components/kanban/ReferencesPicker.tsx` — add `dialog` state, update `pick()` to branch on `result.kind`, conditionally render `{dialog && <FolderPickerDialog .../>}` (mount-per-open, not always-mounted) with `onDone` clearing `dialog` and appending picked refs if any.

4. `e2e/fixtures.ts` — add an optional `options?: { fakePickRefsDir?: boolean }` (default true) to `provisionBackend`, only setting `AGETOR_FAKE_PICK_REFS_DIR` when true; add a new `headlessPickBackend` fixture (own port block after 4900, e.g. 5000/5100) calling it with `{ fakePickRefsDir: false }`. Do not change default behavior for any existing fixture/call site.

5. New file `e2e/folder-picker-dialog.spec.ts` using `headlessPickBackend`, covering: candidate click → chip appears; manual entry (invalid path shows inline error and stays open, then valid path succeeds); files-mode drill-in (plant files under `backend.dataDir`, pick it, click one file row, assert exactly one chip, plus Back returns to the candidate list and Cancel adds nothing).

Do not touch `src/bun/refs-pick.ts`, `src/bun/server.ts`, `src/cli/**`, `NewTaskForm.tsx`, or `RunPanel.tsx`. Run `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` and keep them green; run the new and existing e2e specs.
